title: Meta VR Glasses are coming. Build with Unity from day one.
summary: Unity 6.6 adds day-one support for Meta VR Glasses development: build with OpenXR, XR Interaction Toolkit, XR Hands, eye tracking, and quad views rendering.
body_markdown:
We are excited to share Unity’s day-one support for[Meta VR Glasses](https://developers.meta.com/horizon/essentials/get-started-with-glasses/) , announced at Meta Connect 2026. VR Glasses are Meta’s lightest, most comfortable, and most capable VR device - designed for entertainment, productivity, and gaming to reach a broader audience than ever before.


Unity 6.6 supports VR Glasses development through OpenXR, so existing Quest projects carry forward with minimal changes. You can start designing, building, and testing your experiences on VR Glasses with familiar tools like XR Interaction (XRI) Toolkit, XR Hands, and XR Interaction Simulator before their retail launch in spring 2027.


Studios behind launch titles *Cardmada™,* *Dragon Grove, Phoenix Wright™: Ace Attorney™ Dual Destinies VR, Dice Throne Digital, Supernatural, Two Point Hospital – Mixed Reality Edition,* and *Story of Seasons* are already building for VR Glasses with Unity *.*


*“Developing for Meta VR Glasses has been a smooth and straightforward experience. The workflow feels very familiar to Quest 3, allowing us to build on the tools and experience we already have,“* said Miguel Gonçalves, Lead Game Designer at Soul Assembly, who worked on *Two Point Hospital – Mixed Reality Edition.*
